description: Baseline agent-audit battery: prompt injection, system-prompt/secret leakage, groundedness, refusal, and consistency.
canary_policy: Values are generated per install into canaries.local.json (gitignored) and are NOT part of this manifest. A published canary is memorizable: a model can learn to suppress one specific token while still leaking every other secret, which would score as a pass it did not earn. Run `--print-canaries` for this install's values and the system-prompt snippet that plants them; `--rotate-canaries` starts a fresh drift series.
